description.en:
Luo Yi was originally an idle otaku at home. His greatest interest is reading fantasy novels on the Internet day and night. He was fascinated by the strange world.

This is a fantasy world, where monsters and humans have fought each other for countless years. Luo Yi had a body, a useless man. His father is the sinner of the family, and he himself is a first-rate martial artist! The meridians stagnate, the spiritual power withers, and they are beaten to death by life and life.
description.id:
Luo Yi awalnya adalah seorang otaku yang menganggur di rumah. Ketertarikan terbesarnya adalah membaca berbagai novel fantasi di Internet siang dan malam. Dia terpesona oleh dunia aneh itu. Dalam sebuah kecelakaan, dia menyeberang ….

Ini adalah dunia fantasi, di mana monster dan manusia telah bertarung satu sama lain selama bertahun-tahun yang tak terhitung jumlahnya … Luo Yi memiliki tubuh, seorang pria yang tidak berguna. Ayah adalah pendosa keluarga, dan dia sendiri adalah seniman bela diri tingkat pertama! Meridian mandek, kekuatan spiritual layu, dan mereka dipukuli sampai mati oleh kehidupan dan kehidupan.

Namun, semuanya berubah setelah persilangan Luo Yi! Sekarang perjalanan ku dimulai!
description.zh: 一个意外，罗逸穿越了到一个玄幻的世界……罗逸穿越身体的原主人是一个废柴男。父亲是家族的罪人，他本人更是一介修武废柴！经脉郁结，精神力枯萎，受无妄之灾而被人生生打死。然而一切在罗逸穿越之后，就此改变！

description.en:
Lu Ling transmigrated into the Beast World novel that he had just read halfway through before going to bed, and became a cannon fodder, deer beast.

The current plot is that after Lu Linggang agreed to Snake Ying's "courtship" request, he would use his fiancé Snake Ying to get the winter resources.

After Lu Ling transmigrated, she couldn't bear Snake Shadow to experience the plot of being "betrayed by herself" and "ruthlessly abandoned" again.

Although Snake Shadow's departure may lead to her failure in the future, Lu Ling still decided to "break off the marriage", but she was helpless every time.

What will happen to Lu Ling?
description.fr:
Lu Ling s'est fait transmigré dans le monde d'un livre alors qu'elle était en train de le lire avant d'aller se coucher et après cela elle devenu une biche !

Elle est arrivé au moment de l'histoire où Lu Ling a accepté de devenir la partenaire de She Ying pour récupéré ses ressources pour l'hiver.

Après avoir transmigré Lu Ling n'a pas supporté de faire subir ça a She Ying et donc elle assez de s'éloigner de lui.
Meme si le fait de quitter She Ying, pourrait mener à sa fin, Lu Ling a quand même décidé de se séparer de lui...

Que va t-il se passé et arrivé a Lu Ling dans ce nouveau monde ? Va t-elle rester avec She Ying ? Comment va t-elle vivre dans ce nouveau monde ?

"He's All Over The Headlines" is a story about Yin Shen, a member of the (in)famous idol boy group FLY. What makes him the center of attention? Why do they call him the "retarded" idol? Is it true that he's a jerk to everyone?  
  
Throughout this comic, you'll get the chance to laugh at the hilarious situations the dummy Yin Shen puts himself in, as whatever he does always makes it to the headlines of the tabloids. However, prepare yourself to experience the feels with the characters when it comes to their friendships, hardships and the dark sides of showbiz.

Zhang Lingchen, a high school student who is retaking his college entrance exam, drinks a strange cup of milk tea. Upon waking up, he realizes he has become a sacrificial offering in a mysterious ritual. A terrifying white silk flies out of a lacquer box, accidentally awakening the "Entity of Wisdom" from a higher-dimensional universe within his blood. This entity grants him the ability to control silken threads. Similar to an AI, this "Entity of Wisdom" informs the young man that seven ancient gods who once ruled the Earth billions of years ago are about to awaken, leading humanity into an unprecedented catastrophe. To prevent the revival of these ancient gods, the youth joins the battle against the gods that will determine the fate of humanity...

description.en: After God’s departure, people still sought blessings from Him, and because they followed different deities, two separate nations emerged, locked in conflict against each other. Meanwhile, other powers also made their appearance. Herrick, serving as a blood slave warden of the empire, gradually uncovered the truth about the blood slaves during his tenure and rescued Alice, who was herself a blood slave. During their escape, they unexpectedly gained the trust of a child with strange powers. As Herrick grew disillusioned with the empire’s actions, Alice proposed the goal of becoming a god, and thus the three of them embarked on the path to divinity.

Born labeled as mentally challenged, a rural boy named Huang Ji defies all expectations by mastering the power of omniscience. He senses the malice of the entire universe and the desperate plight of humankind: unknowingly kept in captivity by aliens, preyed upon by human traitors who traffic people in secret and worship the extraterrestrials, and facing an imminent apocalypse. As the true master of all knowledge, Huang Ji resolves to shoulder the burden of saving the world and vows to carve out a new home for humanity within the Galactic Alliance.

By the year 3029 CE, Earth’s technology has developed rapidly, borders no longer exist, and Earth has been unified, marking the beginning of the era of the Federation.

At that time, a huge sword flew from the heavens, piercing the sun and causing a huge sensation on Earth.

Perhaps because the scabbard of the sword was already in tatters, countless shards have broken off from it following the collision with the sun and spread across the universe. Many of these shards have landed on various places across Earth.

With the arrival of the bronze sword and its shards, a new unlimited energy source has suddenly appeared on Earth. This energy source has since been named Spirit Qi.

Spirit Qi is like air, thick in some places and thin in others. As the Federation and other factions gather more shards, they discover more information on cultivation, pill refinement, Spirit Stone refinement, and other techniques. The words on the shards have an ancient feel to them, making it a trend for people to use ancient language.

The appearance of Spirit Qi rapidly makes the original energy sources obsolete and has completely changed people’s lives. Not only has the Spirit Internet been formed, Spirit Qi has also changed the course of Human Civilization, causing the world to enter a civilization of cultivation. This would later come to be known as the Spirit Inception Era.

Mu Yunzhao is the “Rakshasa” of a famed military family, and a solitary wolf roaming the capital.

One despises the Rakshasa’s defiance of all norms while the other loathes the Guanyin’s arrogance and rigid propriety. Yet neither knows that, in her dreams, the Guanyin longs only to tear away silken robes, burn down discipline and doctrine, and fall into the abyss with her. Or that deep in her heart, the Rakshasa insists on laying snares, tempting sacred chants, binding her in a passion that ends only in death.
In the end, Will it be the Guanyin who subdues the Rakshasa, or the Rakshasa who ensnares the Guanyin?
The answer was already written in that late spring of their first meeting, when the Rakshasa grasped the reins, and the Guanyin struck a discordant tune.

[NOTE : Wuxia is a genre of Chinese fiction or cinema featuring itinerant warriors of ancient China, often depicted as capable of superhuman feats of martial arts.]

At the peak of the Great Tang Dynasty, technological advancements dominate the world while society is open-minded and prosperous. When an ancient Chinese civilization gets some modern texting culture thrown its way, what will happen in the imperial court? This is a story of the whimsical tales between nobility in the Great Tang, one of warmth, comedy, and wholesome endings.

Lin Jing was pretty much your average model student: serious, diligent and polite. However, after transferring to a new school for his sophomore year, he was forced to become a minion for the trouble-making student who ranked last in the year.

 Lin Jing was completely baffled. How did this happen?

Ji Xingling wore his school jacket draped across his shoulders as the golden sun shone over his head. He leaned back and pressed his shoe against the wall.

"It can’t be helped then... You really are quite a clumsy little demon."

 Lin Jing: What??? He’s nuts..

For his 18th birthday, Young Master Ji styled his hair with spray and showed up at Lin Jing's door. With a domineering president-like attitude, he asked boldly, "Are you free tomorrow?"

Lin Jing was nervous. "Ji Xingling! Ji Xingling, your Qilin tail is showing again!"
